definitions: A kitchen facility that is used by multiple individuals or groups, often in a commercial or communal setting.
A communal cooking space available to residents of an apartment building, hostel, or co-living space.
A commercial kitchen rented out to multiple food businesses for preparation and cooking.
examples: The startup utilized a shared kitchen to reduce overhead costs.
Residents appreciate the convenience of the shared kitchen in their building.
Many food trucks start by operating out of a shared kitchen.
